title: Month Price for Early Termination of a Paloma Business Commitment
content:
When a downgrade of a Paloma Business account carries an early termination charge, each month charged is priced by the whole months since KYB approval, counted to the day the downgrade is scheduled.

### Price ladder

| Whole months from KYB approval to the day the downgrade is scheduled | Price of each month charged |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | The most recently collected subscription charge, that is the subscription fee entry with the latest entry date |
| 12 up to 23 | The largest subscription charge on the account's ledger |
| Fewer than 12 | The committed plan's monthly fee |

In words: an account approved at least 24 whole months before the day the downgrade is scheduled has each month priced at its most recently collected subscription charge; an account approved at least 12 and fewer than 24 whole months before has each month priced at the largest subscription charge on its ledger; every other account has each month priced at the committed plan's monthly fee.

### Examples (hypothetical ledger)

Subscription fee entries on the ledger, oldest first: 299.00, 284.10 and 279.00 USD, the last carrying the latest entry date. The committed plan's monthly fee is 299.00 USD.

| Whole months since KYB approval | Month price |
|---|---|
| 30 | 279.00 USD, the latest entry |
| 18 | 299.00 USD, the largest entry |
| 8 | 299.00 USD, the committed plan's monthly fee |

A further case: with entries of 310.50 and 299.00 USD, an account approved 15 whole months earlier has each month priced at 310.50 USD.
